section_summary.extract_value: This section details multiple regression analyses performed on two subsamples of a study, divided by an IQ threshold of 104 points. For the subsample with IQ below 104 (N=121), creative potential was predicted by IQ and conscientiousness. For the subsample with IQ above 104 (N=175), openness was the strongest predictor, with intelligence and conscientiousness showing only a trend. The analyses did not find significant predictions for agreeableness in either subsample.
